days.title: Ram Mandir, Hanuman Garhi and Saryu Aarti

stops.name: Hanuman Garhi
stops.note: A hilltop temple reached by a steep flight of steps (one source says 76). A step-free route cannot be promised. Sources give different opening hours, so timings are not stated here.

stops.name: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir
stops.note: Phones, footwear and bags must be left in lockers at the entry. Darshan timings and which aartis need a pass differ between sources, so they are not stated here. Check the official trust portal.

stops.name: Ram Ki Paidi
stops.note: Saryu Aarti in the evening. Entry and the aarti are free. Start time changes with the season (about 6 PM in winter and 7 PM in summer according to some sources). Be there at least 30 minutes early.

booking_notes.text: Passes for Ram Mandir are booked only on the trust's official portal, with a mobile number and OTP. Slots open about 15 days ahead and popular ones go within minutes. Sources disagree on whether plain darshan needs a pass, so confirm on the portal.

elderly_notes: Hanuman Garhi involves a steep flight of steps and no step-free alternative can be promised.
